jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: side view at road level of a LOW concrete bridge passing over a city road in thin white line art. Scene: a big WHITE truck with a tall box trailer, white-filled with thin dark outlines is driving UNDER the low bridge and is jammed: the top of its box trailer is pressed hard against the underside of the concrete bridge, which is cracked and chipped where they touch; the truck is half under the bridge; dust falls. No people. Every object (boats, bowls, buckets, walls, furniture) is drawn WHITE-filled with thin dark outlines, never black-filled; the ground and sky are pure black with thin white lines, no brown, no green, no grey fills.
